WITH customer_data AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_last_name, c_first_name
    FROM customer
),
date_filtered_data AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cd.c_last_name, cd.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_filtered_data dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_data cd ON ss.ss_customer_sk = cd.c_customer_sk
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT cd.c_last_name, cd.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_filtered_data dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_data cd ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cd.c_customer_sk
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT cd.c_last_name, cd.c_first_name, dd.d_date
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_filtered_data dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_data cd ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = cd.c_customer_sk
) hot_cust
LIMIT 100
